def thaw_from_args(parser):
    """Adds command line options for things related to inline thawing
    of icefiles"""
    parser.add_argument('--thaw',
                        action='store_true',
                        help='Thaw the icefiles and then exit')

    parser.add_argument('--thaw-all',
                        action='store_true',
                        help='Thaw all icefiles and then exit')

    parser.add_argument('--thaw-dir',
                        type=str,
                        default='.',
                        help='The directory to thaw the icefiles into')

    parser.add_argument('--thaw-file',
                        type=str,
                        default=None,
                        help='The file to thaw')

    parser.add_argument('--thaw-name',
                        type=str,
                        default=None,
                        help='The name of the thawed file')

    parser.add_argument('--thaw-name-base',
                        type=str,
                        default=None,
                        help='The base name of the thawed file')

    parser.add_argument('--thaw-name-ext',
                        type=str,
                        default=None,
                        help='The extension of the thawed file')

    parser.add_argument('--thaw-name-suffix',
                        type=str,
                        default=None,
                        help='The suffix of the thawed file')

    parser.add_argument('--thaw-name-prefix',
                        type=str,
                        default=None,
                        help='The prefix of the thawed file')

    parser.add_argument('--thaw-name-time',
                        action='store_true',
                        help='The time of the thawed file')

    parser.add_argument('--thaw-name-time-format',
                        type=str,
                        default='%Y%m%d_%H%M%S',
                        help='The time format of the thawed file')

    parser.add_argument('--thaw-name-time-suffix',
                        type=str,
